programmes.d: The road to Turning Point continues as Open Fight Night makes its highly anticipated return for the first time since 2017; anyone can make a challenge, and everyone must accept! When the opportunities are endless, what chaos will unfold?
Elijah returns with a live concert; Cedric Alexander battles Jason Hotch; Indi Hartwell takes on Dani Luna, and so much more.
The fallout from a shocking week in TNA Wrestling continues; hearing from the former TNA World Champion, Mike Santana.
The Thanksgiving Turkey Bowl returns as Ryan Nemeth, Brian Myers, Mance Warner, Trey Miguel, Eric Young and The Hometown Man face off; Trick Williams and Mustafa Ali vs. Leon Slater and Mike Santana.
